title: Book 7 — Polymnia, Chapter 230
paragraphs: Some say that Aristodemos came safely to Sparta in this way and on the pretext I have described; but others say he had been sent as a messenger from the camp, and that when he could have come up in time to find the battle still going on, he was not willing to do so, but lingered on the road and so saved his life, while his fellow messenger reached the battle and was killed.
